summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.3V completed exactly one local-CLI-v1 contract freeze. Status: completed; completeness target: complete after governed push/finalization; phase-entry SHA: 934e1f07fac798417c1b5a25d5b06214a5f62ab3; v0.4.3: unchanged at 63580893b1de4782a694ab802ff7bdebdf29b0e6; runtime: Observed / observe / unavailable; RPAC: RPAC-001 v1.0 FROZEN; scope: local CLI only. Authority: RIHAC-001 v1.0, dedicated one-shot RuntimeInvocationApproval. PB: PBRD-001 v1.0, runtime_dispatch, execution_class adapter. Gates: RDGO-001 v1.0, eleven gates. Schema: RIASC-001 v1.0, closed Draft 2020-12, sixteen required top-level fields, executable schema not implemented. Subject: exact invocation_id / runtime_target / prompt_hash / repo_identity / task_id, with wire names runtime_target_id and repository_identity. Freshness: HEAD, task state/contract, prompt, target, adapter configuration, policy version, expiry; no silent refresh/rebinding. Storage/trust: .pcae/runtime-invocation-approvals/v1/<approval_id>/approval.json, strict schema, subject/scope/provenance, canonical digest, no v1 signature. Expiry: one-shot plus explicit wall clock; no arbitrary period. Consumption: atomic durable dispatch_attempted at gate 9. Crash/retry: pre-marker reuse only after full revalidation; marker consumes authority; uncertainty/failure has no automatic replay; new attempt needs new invocation/fresh approval; at-most-once where provable. PB ALLOW permits only attempting the exact bounded local-CLI dispatch described by the request; it is not authority, capability, process/network/filesystem/credential permission, result trust, or completion. PB facts: invocation; repository; task; phase/conditional session; target; adapter descriptor/version/config; prompt; requested capability; local_cli transport; network=false; filesystem scope; approval ID/digest plus validation projection. approval_present derives only from valid RIHAC evidence. Valid approval means POL-004 is not triggered, so HUMAN_REVIEW is not an automatic duplicate human ceremony; absent approval may yield HUMAN_REVIEW but never dispatch. Precedence remains DENY > HUMAN_REVIEW > ALLOW. POL-005 remains unchanged with a narrow future evolution boundary. Rollback, push, publication, mutations, and dry adapter_invocation/simulation_only=true are backward-compatible and unchanged. Gates: prompt; target; static preflight; human authority; approval validation; PB; RE; process containment/live preflight; durable record; dispatch as first effect; untrusted intake. RE projection: complete request, PB evidence, validated approval reference/freshness, live target/status facts. Phase 99/COMP-002 is mapped, not redefined/activated. Durable items: invocation; repo/task; target; prompt; approval; PB; RE; dispatch intent/state. TOCTOU: HEAD; task; prompt; target; adapter config; executable identity; policy version. PB/RE are not cached across drift. Versioning is MAJOR.MINOR with incompatible widening requiring new major and verification. Interoperability/terminology/security checks passed; artifacts remain separate. Both 3S.2.1 MUST-FIX findings are BLOCKING BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION. Runtime inspect is TRUTHFUL_WITH_LIMITATION. API/network: NOT FROZEN / NOT AUTHORIZED / NOT READY. Local CLI contracts: FROZEN. Production source modified: NO. Execution activated: NO. External runtime invocation: NONE. Dry path unchanged. Runtime unavailable. Article stopped. Private research untouched. Next: 149O.20L.7O.3V.1 independent verification. Human decision required.
